CANONICAL_NAME.value: libDAI (0.3 line, 2012 mirror) -- a C++ library of approximate inference on factor graphs: (loopy) belief propagation, junction tree, mean field, TreeEP, Gibbs, and more (Joris Mooij)

VERSION.value: github.com/dbtsai/libDAI master (a 2012 mirror of the libdai.org 0.3 line; exact version from ChangeLog in the tree; commit in hashes)

value.lineage: Pearl's belief propagation (1982/1988) and its loopy generalisation, exact junction-tree inference, and a dozen approximate methods, in one reference library (JMLR MLOSS 2010) with the standard examples (sprinkler network) and unit tests. The canonical open BELIEF-PROPAGATION implementation; the vault's ldpc-codes does BP only for decoding.

value.built_to: compute marginals and MAP states on graphical models by passing messages along factor-graph edges, exactly on trees and approximately on loopy graphs
value.pressure: exact inference is exponential on loopy graphs; loopy BP may not converge
value.success_means: on a tree, BP marginals equal the exact ones; on loopy graphs, convergence and accuracy are reported

value.failure_condition: loopy BP oscillates or converges to wrong marginals
